result.title: Autonomous Multi-modal Agents for ITOps Observability
result.summary: ITOps observability products must integrate data from different tools and systems. We present ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system that orchestrates observability workflows through collaborative AI agents. Its three-tier architecture features inter-agent communication, specialized LLM-powered agents for data access, schema operations and visualization, and unified tool integration. The system supports natural language to GraphQL translation, GraphQL schema generation, schema mapping, trace data lifecycle management and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering. Its agents are instrumented with agent analytics, so that their model and tool calls can be traced. We evaluate each agent on its own benchmark, scored against gold answers where they exist and by a model judge for schema mapping and chart quality. Query generation on a public benchmark and routing work well with a current open model, and the data lifecycle management agent solves most of its scenarios. The evaluation exposed defects that only appear when prompts, parsers and serving stacks are tested together, and we report them together with their fixes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向 ITOps 可观测性的多模态多智能体系统，编排数据访问、GraphQL 生成与可视化等运维工作流并分项评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于运维场景的智能体工程与工具集成应用，虽涉及多模态数据与调用追踪，但未触及视觉推理中的 latent 状态、证据使用或训练监督，缺乏可供核查的借鉴线索。
